specimens.name: capsule
specimens.note: The site's whole corpus. Subject, the mode it is read under, the parts it is made of.

specimens.name: projected
specimens.note: Adds where it goes. The only form that produces a Capsule, and zero of 441 authored expressions use it.

specimens.name: frame_path
specimens.note: A mode may itself be a path. The frame is not restricted to one token.

specimens.name: three_deep
specimens.note: Each level adds exactly one Frame and one Body. No ceiling was found.

specimens.name: nest_projected
specimens.note: A projection applies to the whole nest, not to the innermost leaf.

specimens.name: induct_join
specimens.note: Coupled by induction. The bond kind is the operator, which inference over shared vocabulary cannot recover.

specimens.name: project_join
specimens.note: One projects into the other. Falsifiable: if nothing downstream changes when the source does, the projection was asserted and never held.

specimens.name: triple
specimens.note: Joins scale linearly. Three operands, three of everything.

specimens.name: mixed
specimens.note: Bond kinds may differ within one chain. Induction then projection.

specimens.name: list_separator
specimens.note: NOT a compound. Two frames but one Operation — the semicolon separates, it does not relate.

specimens.name: prefixed_compound
specimens.note: Two prefixed capsules joined. Op:4 — two operators plus two capsules — and ModifierChain drops to zero, so prefixing both sides changes the shape of the join itself.

specimens.name: lens_over_compound
specimens.note: Two viewpoints, coupled. Reader and writer are different lenses on a related pair.

specimens.name: nest_compound
specimens.note: A nest may be one operand of a compound. Depth and relation compose.

specimens.name: chained_modifiers
specimens.note: Three modifiers, three Capsules. A projection chain — where it goes, then where that goes.

specimens.name: operators_in_body
specimens.note: The strangest verified form. Operators live inside a body as parts — the body holds operations rather than names. Op:4 from three inner operators plus the host.

specimens.name: transdimensional_microinteraction
specimens.note: Transdimensional microinteraction expression. Bounds an input capsule prefix, gesture direction, transformation scene (( )), destination postfix, and perspective/register state.

specimens.name: ground
specimens.note: Grounds without a frame. #> is the only prefix here that takes no [mode] — an address is not read under a mode, it simply holds.

specimens.name: probe
specimens.note: The question is stated and what is already known is not. Two questions share that niche and compete for it.

specimens.name: induct
specimens.note: Charge moves register without loss. The observer is unstated, so a reader can occupy it.

specimens.name: project
specimens.note: Implicit made explicit. Geometry is lift.

specimens.name: settle
specimens.note: A trailing . produces a ModifierChain and no Frame or Body at all. Postfix modifies rather than operates, which is why it can attach to a bare identifier and a prefix cannot.

specimens.name: lens_bare
specimens.note: Both sides claimed, so nothing is left open. The most complete and least extensible position.

specimens.name: lens_framed
specimens.note: Infix survives containers. The lens sits outside the frame and reads the whole capsule through a viewpoint.
